data.title: Umm Al-Qura University Secures US Patent for Antibacterial Compound
data.content:
Makkah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Umm Al-Qura University has registered a new patent with the United States Patent and Trademark Office for an antibacterial chemical compound that inhibits isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase, an enzyme essential for protein synthesis in bacterial cells, opening new possibilities for developing treatments for infections and addressing antibiotic resistance.
    The innovation is expected to support the healthcare sector by advancing the development of novel therapeutic compounds that target bacteria and their growth mechanisms. It also holds potential for developing treatments for skin infections and wounds caused by antibiotic-resistant bacteria, pending further studies to establish efficacy and safety before clinical use.
    The achievement reflects Umm Al-Qura University’s commitment to translating scientific findings into solutions to health challenges and strengthening its role in research, development, and innovation, in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
